info.bio:
The Sugarcubes fueron una banda de rock-pop islandesa que se formó en 1986 y se separó en 1992. Fueron aclamados por la crítica y el público tanto en el Reino Unido como en los Estados Unidos.

Su primer álbum fue Life's Too Good por el cual se dieron a conocer mundialmente con el single "Birthday" gracias a la voz de la cantante Björk.

Después de la separación de los Sugarcubes, Björk continuó con su carrera solista en Londres y se convirtió en una de las cantantes más innovadoras de su género.

scenes.desc: Junto al synth-pop, otros grupos trabajan la atmósfera y acuñan un estilo apagado y melódico que revisa el concepto de pop: Young Marble Giants y Raincoats (proto lo-fi), Felt, Talk Talk (Spirit Of Eden, pionero del slo-core). El revival pop (Everything But The Girl, Sade, Scritti Politti, Prefab Sprout, Style Council, Simply Red); Escocia (Orange Juice, Josef K, Aztec Camera, Blue Nile, el «anorak pop» de los Vaselines) e Irlanda; en Inglaterra, los Smiths (el antídoto del punk, como los Beatles lo fueron del rock'n'roll), Wedding Present, Woodentops, Primitives, Waterboys, Big Audio Dynamite; Roxette y los Sugarcubes de Björk.

podcast.title: Radio Station Break-in and Arrest (1986)
podcast.body: In 1986, while celebrating Reykjavik, Iceland's 200th anniversary, Bjork and the Sugarcubes broke into a government-run radio station. They proceeded to play songs they considered "realistic," leading to their arrest. "When the city of Rechivec Iceland, celebrating the 200th anniversary of its founding in 1986, Bjork and the rest of the sugar cubes, which was her band at the time, broke into the government-run radio station and played songs they thought were realistic. They got arrested for that."

podcast.title: Collector's Item Status
podcast.body: Albums by The Sugarcubes are considered "authentic collector's items" and are highly valued in the market. "Los discos de Osocarquius son una auténtica pizza de coleccionismo, y están verdaderamente cotizados."

podcast.title: International Success and Influence
podcast.body: The Sugarcubes achieved "enormous success," quickly leaving Iceland to become a significant reference point in both the United States and the United Kingdom, maintaining their influence to this day. "tuvieron un enorme éxito, salieron de Islandia muy rápido, y fueron un enorme referente en Estados Unidos, en el rino unido, me recero hoy en día."

podcast.title: Meteoric Rise in Independent Music
podcast.body: The release of their first album marked the beginning of a "tremendous meteoric career" in independent music. "salía el primer disco de Osocarquius, y con él ya empezaba una carrera tremenda meteorica en la música independiente."

podcast.title: Precursor Group Formation
podcast.body: Prior to their official formation, a group featuring "practically all the members" of The Sugarcubes performed their first concerts in the United Kingdom around 1984-1985, doing collaborations and small performances. "con su grupo anterior del que estaban prácticamente todos los miembros de Osocarquius como otro nombre. Ya dieron sus primeros conciertos en el rino unido haciendo colaborando en presentaciones, haciendo pequeñas actuaciones."

xref.title: Radio Station Break-in and Arrest (1986)
xref.body: In 1986, Bjork and her band, The Sugarcubes, broke into a government-operated radio station in Reykjavik, Iceland, during the city's 200th-anniversary celebration. They played songs they deemed "realistic" and were subsequently arrested for the act. "When the city of Rechivec Iceland, celebrating the 200th anniversary of its founding in 1986, Bjork and the rest of the sugar cubes, which was her band at the time, broke into the government-run radio station and played songs they thought were realistic. They got arrested for that."
